headline: Weathered Expanse and Mooring County Shift Again
war_summary: The latest returns show the campaign’s main pressure still concentrated in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, though the balance has altered since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse remains divided among three Warden, two Colonial, and four neutral bases, with 83 strategic-base events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour window; casualties for both sides are accelerating sharply. Mooring County has changed more substantially, now reporting all 12 bases under Warden control, against the earlier nine Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral, while its 24-hour event total stands at 50 and activity has cooled markedly. Stlican Shelf holds its one Warden and eight Colonial bases, with 18 daily events and six in the latest six-hour spell. Marban Hollow remains split one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral after 13 daily events, but its latest recorded action is several hours old. Callahan’s Passage retains all ten Warden bases despite ten events in the day, likewise with no recent movement. Most other sectors report little or no base activity.
